records.notes: JRA A+ capability and A+ public ceiling are approved. Individual meetings remain limited to reviewed canonical fields and human-approved publication.

NAR and local-government racing have an approved A+ system ceiling. NAR monthly convene info remains the national mother-set source and is unioned with independent regional/operator official positive evidence.

South Kanto 4 Racing official quarterly calendar (nankankeiba.com/calendar/YYYYQQ.do with quarter-start months 01/04/07/10) is an independent mother_set source for Urawa, Funabashi, Oi, and Kawasaki. Positive evidence is unioned with NAR; source failure must block absence-based public removal.

Iwate Keiba official monthly calendar is an independent mother_set source for Morioka and Mizusawa. Venue blocks are identified by the official Morioka/Mizusawa calendar markers and their bounded date rows. Positive evidence is unioned with NAR; absence removal requires both NAR monthly convene info and this source to be complete.

Hyogo Prefecture Racing Association's shared Sonoda/Himeji official monthly calendar is an independent mother_set source for Sonoda and Himeji. Positive evidence is unioned with NAR; absence removal requires both NAR monthly convene info and this source to be complete.

The FY2026 Tokai district joint annual official calendar plus Kasamatsu Keiba's official monthly schedule pages are an independent mother_set path for Nagoya and Kasamatsu. The annual PDF is fetched as the fiscal-year joint baseline and the monthly official HTML supplies exact dated code-23/code-24 meeting links for the rolling window. Positive evidence is unioned with NAR; malformed or unavailable official pages block absence removal, and dates outside the FY2026 boundary fail closed until the next fiscal-year source is registered.

Hokkaido Keiba's official monthly calendar is an independent mother_set source for Monbetsu. The Shift_JIS calendar is parsed only from tr.hokkaidokeiba current-month day cells, and a meeting requires the official Hokkaido Keiba logo plus a direct 門別N回M日 marker. Positive evidence is unioned with NAR; absence removal requires both NAR monthly convene info and this source to be complete, while malformed or incomplete month structure fails closed.

Kanazawa Keiba's FY2026 official annual PDF is parsed as a vector calendar: the 12 fiscal-month day grids are matched to the official prefectural/municipal meeting-color bars to recover exact meeting dates. Official monthly table_honba pages supersede the annual baseline when populated and are otherwise cross-checked without treating an unpopulated future page as negative evidence. Positive evidence is unioned with NAR; absence removal requires both NAR monthly convene info and this source to be complete, and PDF/month structure failures fail closed.

Kochi Keiba's FY2026 official annual schedule PDF, published 2026-02-26, is an independent mother_set source for Kochi. Exact meeting dates are recovered from the PDF text-layer month/day grid and the official ☆/◎ home-meeting markers. The separate current scheduler is structurally available but future cells are intentionally unpopulated, so it is not treated as negative mother-set evidence. Positive annual-plan evidence is unioned with NAR; absence removal requires both NAR monthly convene info and the structurally complete requested-month PDF source, while PDF geometry or fiscal-window failures fail closed.
Banei Tokachi has an approved A+ system ceiling. Banei terminology and field interpretation remain separate from flat-racing assumptions.

Saga Keiba's FY2026 annual official schedule PDF is the independent positive mother_set baseline for Saga, with structurally complete published monthly schedule pages contributing newer positive home-meeting evidence. A future monthly 404 is treated as not-yet-published rather than negative evidence. Positive evidence is unioned with NAR; absence removal requires both NAR monthly convene info and this source to be complete, while annual/PDF/monthly structural failures fail closed.
